lines.zh: 我拖着肥大的身体在沙上爬
lines.en: I drag my bloated body across the sand.

lines.zh: 我的腿又短又粗，走得很慢
lines.en: My legs are short and thick; I move slowly.
The top of my head is bare brain.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，沙被压出沟
lines.en: I shift step by step, pressing furrows in the sand.
The sand burns beneath me, and I crawl on.

lines.zh: 我朝虫群聚集的方向走
lines.en: I move toward where the swarm gathers.
My body blocks the whole path.

lines.zh: 我每动一下，就有一层沙滑下来
lines.en: With each move, sand slides off me.
I do not chase; I only press forward.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方留下一道湿痕
lines.en: A wet trail remains where I crawl.

lines.zh: 我抬头闻了闻，转向另一边
lines.en: I raise my head, sniff, and turn aside.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙漠上很圆
lines.en: My shadow is round on the desert.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到岩石的阴影里
lines.en: I shift into the rock's shade.

lines.zh: 我用前腿撑起身体，再放下
lines.en: I prop myself up on my forelegs, then settle.

lines.zh: 我朝那个还在动的东西去
lines.en: I head for whatever is still moving.

lines.zh: 我的节肢在地上发出细响
lines.en: My limbs click softly on the ground.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙上，脑在慢慢跳
lines.en: I lie on the sand, my brain pulsing slowly.

lines.zh: 我不需要眼睛就能知道你在哪
lines.en: I need no eyes to know where you are.
The whole swarm is listening to me.
The sand is hot; I do not care.

lines.zh: 我在想这一片还剩多少活物
lines.en: I am considering what living things remain here.

lines.zh: 我的口器在动，没有出声
lines.en: My mouthparts work, without sound.
This desert is mine.
I slowly shift my weight.
Wind blows sand onto my back.
The swarm knows this body of mine.

lines.zh: 我不急，整片沙漠都在等
lines.en: I am unhurried; the whole desert waits.
I turn my bare brain toward you.
Your thoughts are loud.
I can taste your fear.
I am far larger than you.
Do not run; the swarm is all around.

lines.zh: 我在你身上读到的东西，很有趣
lines.en: What I read in you is interesting.
My mouthparts open a little.
Retreat, and my swarm will follow.

lines.zh: 你站在这儿，就是站在我的地上
lines.en: Standing here is standing on my ground.

lines.zh: 我没有退，只是缩了一下
lines.en: I do not pull back; I only flinch.

lines.zh: 这一下在我身体上开了口
lines.en: That opened a wound in me.

lines.zh: 我叫不出来，我的声音很低
lines.en: I cannot cry out; my voice is low.
The swarm presses closer.
My brain pulses faster.
The swarm can make up for this.
I press a little forward.
You cannot slip past what I sense.
You will pay far more.

lines.zh: 你的念头比东西更吸引我
lines.en: Your thoughts interest me more than what you hold.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，虫群替我吃
lines.en: I do not eat; the swarm eats for me.
This means nothing.
You hold it up, and your hand shakes.

lines.zh: 你放下它，我也不会放过你
lines.en: Set it down and I still will not spare you.
This is worth less than sand.
I let the swarm look first.

lines.zh: 你把东西扔了，我听见了
lines.en: You threw it away; I heard.
I need no bribes.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞在一团肉上
lines.en: You hit me like a mass of flesh.

lines.zh: 我没有退，只是内陷了一下
lines.en: I do not retreat; I only dent.

lines.zh: 这一下我几乎没有感觉
lines.en: I hardly felt that.
My body spreads the force away.
You bounce off onto the sand.
Sand billows up.
My legs pull in slightly.
I turn toward you, slowly.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我知道了你的分量
lines.en: That told me your weight.
The swarm does not continue by pairing.

lines.zh: 我在这里，是为了生下更多
lines.en: I am here to spawn more.
My body is full of eggs.
The swarm will tend them.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴侣，我只需要时间
lines.en: I need no partner, only time.
The desert is large enough for the whole swarm.
Worker bugs circle me.
I bury the eggs under the sand.
This is my duty.
I have no tenderness, only use.

lines.zh: 我用口器夹起来，看了看
lines.en: I take it in my mouthparts and look.
This is far too fine.
I hand it to a nearby worker.
It grows wet in my grip.
It fell; I paid no mind.
I push it with a foreleg.
This would make me sick.
I toss it back to the swarm.
The swarm has already closed in.

lines.zh: 我不用动，它们会替我动手
lines.en: I need not move; they will act for me.
You cannot leave this ground.
I have read your direction.

lines.zh: 你回头看，虫群就在那里
lines.en: Look back; the swarm is there.
I want to watch you dragged down.
I am patient; the desert will wait for you to tire.
You run fast; that is good.
This ground is mine.
I raise myself slightly.
It has begun now.

lines.zh: 虫群跟着你，我跟着虫群
lines.en: The swarm follows you; I follow the swarm.

lines.zh: 你在沙上留下的脚印很清楚
lines.en: Your prints in the sand are clear.

lines.zh: 我不快，但整片沙漠都是我的
lines.en: I am slow, but the whole desert is mine.

lines.zh: 你躲到石头后，虫群绕过去
lines.en: You hide behind rock; the swarm goes around.
I hear your breathing grow heavy.
Bugs move beneath the sand.
Your steps have grown uneven.
The deeper you go, the more you are mine.
I wait for you to fall on your own.

lines.zh: 虫群已经把你围在中间
lines.en: The swarm has you surrounded.
I raise my head, slowly.
I press down with a foreleg.
That pinned the sand along with you.
My mouthparts clamp your shoulder.
You cannot move beneath me.
Slime covers your face.
I tighten slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下不带怒气，只是工作
lines.en: That carried no anger, only work.
I raise my foreleg again.
You are still struggling; I am surprised.
The swarm will handle the rest.

lines.zh: 沙面鼓起，我从下面升上来
lines.en: The sand bulges; I rise from beneath.
My brain breaks the sand first.

lines.zh: 这片沙漠早就是虫群的
lines.en: This desert has long been the swarm's.
My weight sinks the sand deeply.

lines.zh: 周围的沙里爬出许多工虫
lines.en: Many workers crawl out of the surrounding sand.
I smell something new.

lines.zh: 我的身体还没完全从沙里出来
lines.en: My body has not fully left the sand.
The heat here is just right.
The swarm parts; I move forward.
I wait on the sand.

lines.zh: 火烤我的身体，表面裂开
lines.en: Fire bakes me and my surface splits.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下去，砸进沙里
lines.en: I fall from height and crash into the sand.
Water fills me; I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把沙和虫一起掀起来
lines.en: The blast throws sand and bugs alike.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打进我的身体，卡住了
lines.en: Something drives into me and lodges.
That force grips my brain.
I am not hungry; the swarm eats for me.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我整个身体一亮
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand; my whole body lights up.
No sand below; I keep falling.
